title: Creamy Mushroom Stew
description: Mushroom stew in Minecraft is called mushroom_stew. For the resource pack, use the name "Creamy Mushroom Stew" which makes it look creamy and more delicious but adds no new features. Compatible with versions 1.20.6 to 1.21.4. Only visual changes.
body:
This resource pack visually enhances mushroom stew to make it look creamy and more delicious with a golden appearance. It does not add any new features or change gameplay mechanics. Pure graphical improvement only. Fully compatible with Minecraft versions 1.20.6 through 1.21.4.
## **Creating or customizing mod packs and resource packs: modpacks.max@gmail.com**
